actions.sql: SELECT SUM(COALESCE(r_cethze.c_zrmfjv, 0) * r_cethze.c_fxmtyq - COALESCE(refunds.total_refund, 0)) AS total_net_order_value FROM r_cethze LEFT JOIN (SELECT c_mtkmad, SUM(c_aveqma) AS total_refund FROM r_ryvife GROUP BY c_mtkmad) AS refunds ON r_cethze.c_vhisdc = refunds.c_mtkmad INNER JOIN (SELECT c_vywrxa FROM r_mncdaq WHERE c_zwqqee = 1 AND c_yzzymz = 'Silver') AS silver_customers ON r_cethze.c_kujczn = silver_customers.c_vywrxa WHERE r_cethze.c_xeysvm IN ('confirmed', 'pending')
